cost_source.basis: GitHub billing API — consumed AI credits (grossQuantity), read once before and once after the run. 1 credit = $0.01.
cost_source.caveat: The delta is account-wide: it is accurate only while this account makes no other Copilot requests during the run.
cost_source.unavailable_when: Copilot licence billed via an org/enterprise (user-level endpoint returns no usage), or the token lacks 'Plan' user permission (read).
